problems.title: Fix these before publishing
problems.intro: The form cannot go live yet:

reason.crm_required_unbound: A property your workspace requires is not in the form.
reason.no_contact_point: Add an email or phone field linked to the contact, so every submission can be matched to a person.

code.no_contact_point: Add an email or phone field linked to the contact, so every submission can be matched to a person.
code.no_options: A choice field needs at least one option, and every option needs a label.
code.duplicate_option: A choice field has two options with the same label.
code.bad_range: A field has a minimum above its maximum.
code.constant_empty: A hidden field set to a constant value has no value.
code.crm_required_unbound: Your workspace requires the CRM property "{property}": add it to the form and mark it required.
code.crm_required_optional: A field linked to a required CRM property must be required.
code.redirect_not_https: The redirect address must start with https://.
code.too_large: The form is too large. Remove some fields.

builder.versionsFailed: The versions could not be loaded.
builder.versionsEmpty: This form has not been published yet.

restore.title: Restore version {n}?
restore.message: The draft is replaced by this version. The live form does not change until you publish.
restore.messageDirty: The draft is replaced by this version, and your unsaved changes are lost. The live form does not change until you publish.

leave.title: Leave without saving?
leave.message: You have unsaved changes to this form. If you leave now they are lost.

build.formDescriptionHint: Shown above the fields. You can use b, i, u, br, ul, ol, li and a tags.

palette.title: Add to the form
palette.hiddenHint: Saved with each submission without the visitor seeing them, for example where they came from.
palette.crmHint: Add a field that fills a contact or company property, custom ones included.
palette.propertiesFailed: The CRM properties could not be loaded. You can still add plain fields.
palette.full: The form has reached its limit of blocks.

list.title: Fields
list.emptyMessage: Add fields from the list. A form needs a way to reach the person, so link an email or phone field to the contact.

inspector.kindLocked: The type follows the CRM property.
inspector.rangeBad: The minimum cannot be above the maximum.
inspector.patternHint: A regular expression the text must match. Leave empty for none.
